concepts.label: Person
concepts.definition: An individual, distinct from the software agent acting for them.

concepts.label: Organization
concepts.definition: A university, laboratory, team or other organization.

concepts.label: Place
concepts.definition: A physical location, including a room or conference venue.

concepts.label: Preference
concepts.definition: An explicitly expressed preference. A preference is not an authorization.

concepts.label: Source record
concepts.definition: A versioned record used as evidence for knowledge, distinct from the object it describes.

concepts.label: Human competency
concepts.definition: A person's explicitly stated professional ability; not an executable agent skill.

relations.definition: The person belongs to the organization.
The person explicitly expressed the preference.
The person explicitly claims the competency.

concepts.label: Project
concepts.definition: An organized body of work. This local type is not equated to Schema.org Project, which is an Organization.

concepts.label: Goal
concepts.definition: A desired outcome, distinct from the task undertaken to achieve it.

concepts.label: Task
concepts.definition: A concrete action commitment, with a state and optional deadline.

concepts.label: Decision
concepts.definition: A recorded choice and its rationale. An ordinary decision record never grants agent execution authority.

relations.definition: The project or task pursues a goal.
The task belongs to this project.
The work item belongs to the person.

concepts.label: Time interval
concepts.definition: A bounded interval in the fictional conference week and Asia/Shanghai timezone.

concepts.label: Calendar event
concepts.definition: An occupied or explicitly offered interval. The demo's Free intervals are already offered for academic coordination, not inferred from missing events.

relations.definition: The calendar event occurs during the interval.
The calendar entry belongs to the person.

concepts.label: Document
concepts.definition: An information work, distinct from its particular versions or physical copies.

concepts.label: Document version
concepts.definition: A specific immutable version of an information work.

concepts.label: Selected excerpt
concepts.definition: A selected section from a specific source version. Selection does not make private material public.

concepts.label: Paper
concepts.definition: A scholarly manuscript or paper; publication and permission to redistribute are separate facts.

concepts.label: Research note
concepts.definition: A personal research note with explicit sources and disclosure status.

relations.definition: The concrete version is a version of the information work.
The excerpt is taken from the exact version.
The assertion or work is supported by this source record.

modules.name: Research goals, conferences and learning plans

concepts.label: Research project
concepts.definition: A local work project organized around research questions.

concepts.label: Research question
concepts.definition: A question that guides research and requires appropriate evidence.

concepts.label: Research topic
concepts.definition: A subject in the owner's concept scheme; a topic label alone is not proof of equivalence.

concepts.label: Conference
concepts.definition: A whole conference containing program sessions and individual presentations.

concepts.label: Program session
concepts.definition: A program grouping of presentations or other activities, not one individual talk.

concepts.label: Presentation
concepts.definition: One individually identified scholarly presentation within an event.

concepts.label: Attendance plan
concepts.definition: A proposed or confirmed personal plan to attend activities.

concepts.label: Reading plan
concepts.definition: A reading commitment serving explicit research questions.

relations.definition: The research project addresses this question.
The research question concerns the topic.
The conference contains the program grouping.
The session contains this individual presentation.
The material or presentation discusses the topic.
The reading or attendance plan serves the research question.

concepts.label: Discussion plan
concepts.definition: A collaborative discussion plan whose drafts are distinct from externally confirmed arrangements.

concepts.label: Agenda item
concepts.definition: An item proposed for a discussion, with its material sources.

concepts.label: Material package
concepts.definition: A collection of references to materials actually available to its owner.

concepts.label: Venue requirement
concepts.definition: The capacity, equipment and time constraints for a discussion.

concepts.label: Reservation proposal
concepts.definition: An exact proposed reservation. Preparing or approving a proposal does not prove the booking exists.

concepts.label: Confirmed reservation
concepts.definition: A reservation supported by a booking-service receipt.

relations.definition: The discussion plan includes the agenda item.
The agenda item uses the specified available document version.
The discussion plan has these venue requirements.
The reservation proposal or confirmed reservation concerns this place.
